description: Our teams goal is to create a compelling collection of information and stories regarding the space equipment abandoned by NASA, to help engage/interest the future generation in the world of NASA and astrophysics in general.
summary: When looking at all the different challenges, this one stood out to us all because we were already interested in the achievements humanity has made in space exploration. However, we didn't know much about the actual artifacts and spacecrafts that completed these influential missions and what happened to them after their tasks were completed. This is why we decided to research three of these interesting artifacts of human achievement and portray it in a way that is engaging and appealing for a younger audience, like ourselves, as well.
details: Our project is dedicated to 3 pioneer missions that greatly contributed to human progress and space exploration but had to be left behind either intentionally or due to unforeseen circumstances. Many stories of their past are limited to what happened during their lifetime, and what happens after is often left untold. We hope our projecr will shine a well-deserved light on the fate of these revolutionary missions.
